1: // Simple Space Junk Collector game
2: // Canvas element with id="game" must exist in the page.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return;
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   const W = canvas.width = canvas.width || 800;
9:   const H = canvas.height = canvas.height || 600;
10: 
11:   // Game settings
12:   const shipWidth = 40;
13:   const shipHeight = 20;
14:   const hookWidth = 4;
15:   const hookSpeed = 6;
16:   const debrisSpeed = 2;
17:   const spawnInterval = 1000; // ms
18:   const gameDuration = 60; // seconds
19: 
20:   let left = false, right = false, fire = false;
21:   let score = 0;
22:   let timeLeft = gameDuration;
23:   let lastSpawn = 0;
24:   let lastTimerTick = performance.now();
25:   let gameOver = false;
26: 
27:   const ship = {
28:     x: W / 2 - shipWidth / 2,
29:     y: H - shipHeight - 5,
30:     w: shipWidth,
31:     h: shipHeight,
32:     speed: 5,
33:   };
34: 
35:   const hook = {
36:     active: false,
37:     extending: false,
38:     x: 0,
39:     y: 0,
40:     length: 0,
41:     maxLen: H / 2,
42:   };
43: 
44:   const debris = [];
45: 
46:   // Input handling
47:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
48:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') left = true;
49:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') right = true;
50:     if (e.key === ' ') fire = true;
51:   });
52:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
53:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') left = false;
54:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') right = false;
55:     if (e.key === ' ') fire = false;
56:   });
57: 
58:   function spawnDebris() {
59:     const size = Math.random() * 20 + 10;
60:     const isDanger = Math.random() < 0.2; // asteroid
61:     debris.push({
62:       x: Math.random() * (W - size),
63:       y: -size,
64:       w: size,
65:       h: size,
66:       speed: debrisSpeed + Math.random(),
67:       danger: isDanger,
68:       captured: false,
69:     });
70:   }
71: 
72:   function update(dt) {
73:     if (gameOver) return;
74: 
75:     // Move ship
76:     if (left) ship.x -= ship.speed;
77:     if (right) ship.x += ship.speed;
78:     ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(W - ship.w, ship.x));
79: 
80:     // Hook logic
81:     if (fire && !hook.active) {
82:       hook.active = true;
83:       hook.extending = true;
84:       hook.x = ship.x + ship.w / 2 - hookWidth / 2;
85:       hook.y = ship.y;
86:       hook.length = 0;
87:     }
88:     if (hook.active) {
89:       if (hook.extending) {
90:         hook.length += hookSpeed;
91:         if (hook.length >= hook.maxLen) hook.extending = false;
92:       } else {
93:         hook.length -= hookSpeed;
94:         if (hook.length <= 0) hook.active = false;
95:       }
96:       // Collision with debris while extending
97:       if (hook.extending) {
98:         const tipX = hook.x + hookWidth / 2;
99:         const tipY = hook.y - hook.length;
100:         debris.forEach(d => {
101:           if (!d.captured && tipX > d.x && tipX < d.x + d.w && tipY > d.y && tipY < d.y + d.h) {
102:             d.captured = true;
103:             score += d.danger ? 0 : 10; // danger gives no points
104:           }
105:         });
106:       }
107:     }
108: 
109:     // Update debris
110:     debris.forEach(d => {
111:       if (!d.captured) d.y += d.speed;
112:     });
113:     // Remove off‑screen or captured debris
114:     for (let i = debris.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
115:       const d = debris[i];
116:       if (d.captured) {
117:         // simple retract effect: nothing to do
118:         debris.splice(i, 1);
119:         continue;
120:       }
121:       if (d.y > H) {
122:         // lost debris – end game
123:         gameOver = true;
124:       }
125:       // collision with ship (danger only)
126:       if (d.danger &&
127:           d.x < ship.x + ship.w && d.x + d.w > ship.x &&
128:           d.y < ship.y + ship.h && d.y + d.h > ship.y) {
129:         gameOver = true;
130:       }
131:     }
132: 
133:     // Spawn new debris
134:     if (performance.now() - lastSpawn > spawnInterval) {
135:       spawnDebris();
136:       lastSpawn = performance.now();
137:     }
138: 
139:     // Timer
140:     const now = performance.now();
141:     if (now - lastTimerTick >= 1000) {
142:       timeLeft--;
143:       lastTimerTick = now;
144:       if (timeLeft <= 0) gameOver = true;
145:     }
146:   }
147: 
148:   function draw() {
149:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
150: 
151:     // Ship
152:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0cf';
153:     ctx.fillRect(ship.x, ship.y, ship.w, ship.h);
154: 
155:     // Hook
156:     if (hook.active) {
157:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
158:       ctx.fillRect(hook.x, hook.y - hook.length, hookWidth, hook.length);
159:     }
160: 
161:     // Debris
162:     debris.forEach(d => {
163:       ctx.fillStyle = d.danger ? '#f44' : '#aaa';
164:       ctx.fillRect(d.x, d.y, d.w, d.h);
165:     });
166: 
167:     // UI
168:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
169:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
170:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 20);
171:     ctx.fillText(`Time: ${timeLeft}`, W - 100, 20);
172:     if (gameOver) {
173:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
174:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
175:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
176:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
177:       ctx.font = '32px sans-serif';
178:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', W / 2, H / 2 - 20);
179:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
180:       ctx.fillText(`Final Score: ${score}`, W / 2, H / 2 + 20);
181:     }
182:   }
183: 
184:   function loop(timestamp) {
185:     const dt = timestamp - (lastFrame || timestamp);
186:     lastFrame = timestamp;
187:     update(dt);
188:     draw();
189:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
190:   }
191:   let lastFrame = null;
192:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
193: })();
